sec.title: September 1 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 567)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 1** across classic pulp detective mysteries and the glamorous Broadway footlights of the *Little Theater off Times Square*, Lon Clark in *Nick Carter, Master Detective* (1944, 1946), alongside a four-decade retrospective of *The First Nighter Program* starring Don Ameche, June Meredith, Barbara Luddy, Les Tremayne, and Olan Soule for Campana Italian Balm (1933, 1939, 1949, 1953):
